div.span: Inputs: stock assessment data - mortality at age (M or Z), fecundity at age, age classes
Outputs: population growth rate (r), survival at age (lx) and reproductive output at age (mx)

*currently, r values from this function are converted to lambdas (raised to the power of e), which are then used as outputs for the LTR. Depending on the type of future change being measured with this code for my project, it might be worth it to switch from lambdas to lx and/or mx as the main output of this function
